title: Hostile review request schema and storage
body: Persist ReviewRequest and QueueItem in EF with three-provider migrations. Reject serialized request JSON over 1048576 bytes before insert. Enforce workspace isolation on submit.

acceptanceCriteria.text: HostileReviewEntity round-trips on Sqlite, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server.
Valid submit creates a queued row with stable id.
Payload over 1048576 bytes is rejected with no queue row.
Foreign workspace is 403 with no row.
